remarks: First-time buyers, imagine getting your down payment back via the 5% GST rebate on this pristine, brand-new, MOVE-IN-READY home! Investors & downsizers, this TRUE STAND-ALONE detached gem has absolutely NO condo/strata fees—no shared walls, no monthly dues, just pure equity and privacy. Step inside to an impressive open-concept main floor offering 9-ft ceilings & a massive window that floods the living space with natural light & a custom-built feature wall. The chef's kitchen shines with floor-to-ceiling custom cabinetry, gleaming quartz countertops, & a window above the sink. Upstairs, you'll find 3 generous bedrooms, 2.5 sleek baths, a handy computer nook, and convenient main-floor laundry. The possibilities continue below with a separate side entrance leading to an unspoiled basement featuring a large window and full bathroom rough-in—ideal for a future rental suite or extra rec room. Located just 12 minutes to St. Albert and only 4 minutes to grocery stores, this is the home you don't want to miss! (id:67522)
